title: Famous verses
note: A reference names the book, chapter and verse: John 3:16 is the Gospel of John, chapter 3, verse 16. Wording here follows the King James Version; modern translations phrase these verses differently but keep the same references.

src.t: The King James Version of the Bible, Project Gutenberg eBook #10
